entities.name: PMID:27489502
observations: Xie et al., Int J Biol Sci (2016), DOI:10.7150/ijbs.14077; intermittent PTH was administered to 2- and 4-month-old Fgfr3-knockout and wild-type mice for four weeks.

entities.name: FGFR3
observations: FGFR3 deficiency did not eliminate the skeletal anabolic response to intermittent PTH in the reported mouse study.

entities.name: Parathyroid hormone
observations: Intermittent PTH increased BMD, femoral mechanical properties, trabecular BV/TV, and histomorphometric bone formation and resorption in both wild-type and Fgfr3-deficient mice.

entities.name: PTH response intact
observations: In a four-week mouse study, intermittent PTH improved BMD and femoral mechanical properties and increased trabecular BV/TV in both Fgfr3−/− and wild-type mice; knockout osteoblasts retained PTH-stimulated proliferation, differentiation, marker expression, and ERK1/2 phosphorylation.
